meta.note: Finance: documented commitments from the de-duplicated finance events, summed by origin and year; swap-line drawdowns and lower-confidence amounts are reported apart. Trade: reported exports (UN Comtrade) in US$ million to six decimals (a US$1 grain, so a small flow never reads as 0); WLD is the reported world total, ROW the world total minus the two actors and null whenever either partner has no row (an absent cell is never read as 0).
